name: Grain
one_liner: Grain is an AI meeting-recorder/notes platform whose public REST API (recordings, transcripts, notes, hooks) and official remote MCP server let developers pull meeting data and automate workflows.

notes: Grain's public REST API requires a bearer token (Personal Access Token or Workspace Access Token, generated in account/workspace settings) or OAuth2 for third-party distributed integrations. No free tier: PAT access needs Starter plan or above; WAT needs Business/Enterprise and admin rights. All requests need a Public-Api-Version header (current: 2025-10-31). API surface is small (~20 endpoints: recordings, hooks/webhooks, users/teams/meeting types, OAuth token mgmt). Grain also ships an official hosted remote MCP server (https://api.grain.com/_/mcp) using OAuth, exposing meeting recordings/notes/transcripts/deals/coaching data with built-in report prompts — this MCP path could give agent builders a self-serve-ish route via OAuth without a paid PAT, but the underlying REST API itself is paid-gated.
